name: Tonga
title: Ceyo Tonga | Autonomous AI Cloud Agents
description: Deploy autonomous AI agents in Tonga with dedicated 24/7 cloud computers. Automate web research, trade workflows, and Telegram tasks across the islands.
sub: Run dedicated AI specialists on private cloud computers that work 24/7. Connect your apps, manage operations via Telegram, and keep your business moving even across remote island connections.
audience: Tongan tourism operators, agricultural exporters, import-export merchants, logistics coordinators, and remote professionals balancing operations across Tongatapu, Vavaʻu, and the diaspora.
manifesto: Across the Kingdom's scattered islands, distance and intermittent connections should never halt productivity. Ceyo keeps isolated cloud computers working continuously, managing trade, bookings, and research so your enterprise operates globally without interruption.

uses.d: Your agent manages booking requests, drafts itinerary responses for whale-watching expeditions, and updates reservation spreadsheets via Gmail and Google Sheets around the clock.
Monitor overseas commodity prices for Tongan vanilla, squash, and kava, generating automated weekly market intelligence reports delivered right to your Telegram.
Track cargo manifests and vessel schedules connecting Nukuʻalofa to Haʻapai and Vavaʻu, auto-filling customs documentation and logging delays into Notion.
Reconcile cross-border family business invoices between New Zealand, Australia, and Tonga, keeping foreign currency totals aligned across multiple accounts.
Set your cloud browser to scan official regional portals and trade boards daily, extracting public procurement notices and alerting your team immediately.
Automate stock checks across Nukuʻalofa storefronts by having your agent run scripts that compare supplier catalogs and draft restock purchase orders.

steps.d: Start your 3-day free trial on Plus, Pro, or Ultra with up to 1,000,000 tokens daily.
Link your Telegram, connect apps like Gmail and Slack, and assign specialized tasks to your cloud computer.
Turn off your laptop or phone while your agents continue executing research, coding, and automations.

chapters.d: You wake up to a consolidated Telegram briefing summarizing overnight charter inquiries from North America and current fuel prices across the Pacific. Your bot has already pre-sorted priority messages and flagged urgent shipping updates.
While you meet suppliers at the Talamahu Market, your agent opens supplier portals in its cloud browser, extracts price quotes for building materials, and organizes them into a shared Google Sheet.
Your coding agent builds and tests an automated customer intake form for your eco-lodge, deploying it directly from its cloud computer without needing local server configuration.
Even after you disconnect for family prayer and evening rest, your scheduled routines continue monitoring foreign exchange rates and compiling research documents for tomorrow.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three plans: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; a payment card is linked at signup and charged only after the trial concludes unless cancelled.

faq.q: Does Ceyo work when my local internet or phone is offline?
faq.a: Yes. Every Ceyo bot runs on its own isolated cloud computer in secure data centers. It continues browsing, running scripts, and managing scheduled tasks 24/7, regardless of local power outages or severed internet cables in Tonga.

faq.q: Can I manage my AI bots through Telegram?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can interact with your agents individually on Telegram or add multiple specialized bots to a group chat where they collaborate as a coordinated team to solve complex tasks.

faq.q: What languages can my Ceyo agents understand and write?
faq.a: Your bots can communicate fluently in English, Tongan, and dozens of other global languages, making them ideal for bridging domestic operations with overseas partners and customers.

faq.q: Which software applications can Ceyo integrate with?
faq.a: Ceyo connects to over 1,000 popular business applications including Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Drive), Slack, Notion, calendars, CRMs, and developer platforms via built-in secure integrations.
